description: Generate a fix prompt for a weekly finding or a Search Console opportunity. Prepare a coding-agent prompt from an owned report. One check uses one unit; full uses three. Three units are free once. Then US$0.10 per unit, or included in an active PageAudit plan. Read prompt_allowance first. Only send credit_token after explicit spending authorization; preserve request_id for retries. Three lifetime free units per account or anonymous network. A check uses one; full uses three. Extra units cost US$0.10 each. Active Starter, Pro and Agency plans include prompts while valid, within 60 requests/hour. No partial free debit: a full prompt needs three free units or is charged in full. The licensed prompt is saved for this owner and organization. Reopening the same selector is free even after plan expiry. Preserve its text and license; use it only for license.domain. Reuse the UUID v4 request_id and identical body after a delivery failure. Payment uses X-Credito or the x402 challenge. Never charge without the user's authorization. Uses saved observations only; does not start a new collection. Missing evidence is not charged.

check_id.description: Weekly finding type, or opportunity for Search Console. Required for check; absent for full.

language.description: Language of the prompt instructions and check names: en for English, pt for Portuguese.

query.description: Exact opportunity query; required for Search Console check.

request_id.description: New UUID v4 per generation. Keep it unchanged for retries.
